name: std::ranges::elements_of

declarations.code:
template <ranges::range R, class Allocator = std::allocator<std::byte>>

struct elements_of;

intro: Encapsulates a range. Specializations of elements_of act as a tag in overload sets to disambiguate when a range should be treated as a sequence rather than a single value.
